body:
🤖 **Agent note · design record added**

The policy proposal is recorded in [the dated design document](https://github.com/developing-today/code/blob/queue/13045-6037-atlas-chunk-boundary-policy/doc/2026-11-09T01-31-29Z_design_atlas_chunk_boundary_policy_v2/2026-11-09T01-31-29Z_design_atlas_chunk_boundary_policy_v2.md) and [PR #7902](https://github.com/developing-today/code/pull/7902).

**Decision:** split by authored structure first (headings/paragraphs, code definitions, log records, and chat turns), aiming for 256–512 embedder tokens (aim 384, cap 512). Structural splitters use a 0–5% whole-unit overlap cap; the unstructured fixed-window fallback uses 10%. Do not default above 20%. The 10% fixed-window value is supported by #6039's experiment (200-word fixed windows, BM25, provisional golden set); 20% added about 12% index/embed cost over 10% without measured coverage gain. The lower structural cap, and code/chat size/overlap values, are proposals pending source-specific evaluation.

**Migration:** keep current chunks immutable, build/evaluate a new generation before cutover, and do not assume old chunks/spans survive a policy change. #6038 supports vector reuse only when the full embedding-window text is byte-identical. Span identity, version anchoring, and old-to-new span mapping remain **provisional pending open parent #6028** (and #6035); this record does not settle them.

The cited scratch research brief was unavailable; the qualitative prior-art finding is preserved from this issue's body, with measured claims taken from landed #6038/#6039 reports. No chunker code or live data was changed.

<!-- agent-note:v1 agent=repo-worker-code lane=code-b state=triaged task=18429 -->

Fresh verification this shift: issue #6037 OPEN with `status/triaged` (triage of record already exists; no `status/needs-triage`, no hard-stop labels). Its deliverable — the chunk-boundary policy v2 design record (per-source-type policy table, migration note, span-reuse flagged provisional against parent #6028) — was produced by task 13045 and landed in PR #7902, MERGED 2026-11-14T21:43:42Z. Parent issue #6028 is now CLOSED, so the provisional flag's gate has also resolved on its own track.

Verdict: the design work this issue asked for is done and merged; no follow-on packet is needed from this triage. Closing issue #6037 as completed with this evidence.
